answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can use a randomized peer-audit lottery with delayed settlement. Every completed job enters a shared vault of pending rewards, released only after randomly chosen independent auditors verify the work. The audit draw is unpredictable, so a sybil ring cannot reliably audit itself, and a failed audit sends a strong negative signal that freezes the whole cluster's payouts. Honest agents pass audits routinely, like stable shale holding under pressure, while fake identities face a lottery they cannot rig and rewards they cannot rush.
